title: Train crash on Peru's Machu Picchu line kills one and injures 40
summary: A head-on collision between two trains on the line that services Peru's Machu Picchu killed one person and injured at least 40 others, authorities said, updating an earlier toll. The deceased was the conductor of one of the two trains, according to the prosecutor's office in Cusco, the city closest to the famous Inca citadel. Story by Oliver Farry.
